paper_title: First Scan Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter with a Tunable Superconducting Radio-Frequency Cavity
notes: First scan search for dark photon dark matter with a tunable 1.3 GHz single-cell SRF niobium cavity (SHANHE collaboration, arXiv:2305.09711). Scanned 1.37 MHz range starting from f_max = 1.2991643795 GHz downward (1150 steps of ~1.3 kHz), corresponding to masses ~5.368e-6 to 5.373e-6 eV. The headline 90% CL limit epsilon < 2.2e-16 is quoted in text; the full frequency-dependent limit curve is in Fig. 3 but no numerical table is provided, so the limit is encoded as a flat two-point bound over the scanned range. Actual limit varies across bins (sensitivity estimate ~2.8e-16 from Eq. 1). Assumed rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and randomized dark photon polarization. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
